referenceProcedure.rule: Compare every new frame before publishing; approved families remain untouched.

galleryRule: The animation gallery must render the currently selected character style; it may never silently fall back to the default character. V18 legacy run remains separately selectable and locked.
row17FloorRule: Crouch, rise, pickup and low-climb use Conrad row 17 and anchor on its actual last source pixel: ground 47. Do not return them to 46.

rejectedReplacements.reason: Rejected by the user; never reuse for playable run.

run.changePolicy: Never modify this data. It remains available as the legacy character even when another character is the default.

defaultRun.source: Conrad B. Hart sheet row 4, cells 1-20
defaultRun.mapping: one-to-one authored Conrad run sequence; no generated or substituted frames
